instruction:
Resolve six hypothetical publication cases using UKRI policy and FAQ HTML, https://wellcome.org/research-funding/guidance/ending-a-grant/open-access-guidance/open-access-policy and its compliance/funding guidance, and https://erc.europa.eu/manage-your-project/open-science. All acknowledge the funder, report peer-reviewed funded results, and meet technical and data-statement requirements. U1: a UKRI article submitted 1 April 2022 to a subscription journal, with an immediate CC BY accepted manuscript in an institutional repository and no fee. U2: a UKRI monograph published 1 February 2025 from a project ended 31 January 2017, closed access, requesting open-access funding. W1: a Wellcome article published 1 February 2025 in a subscription journal, with an immediate CC BY accepted manuscript in Europe PMC and an APC request. W2: a Wellcome monograph on that date, an open-access fee paid, released in Europe PMC after six months under CC BY-NC. E1: an ERC Horizon 2020 physical-sciences article published during the grant, deposited immediately but opened after seven months. E2: an ERC Horizon Europe chapter in a partly closed book, deposited immediately under CC BY-NC in a trusted repository, with its fee charged during the grant. Return six rows separating scope, compliance verdict, required version/repository, deadline, licence, fee eligibility and its conditions, with section-level citations. Give a minimal correction for each defect and three contrasts between publication obligations and eligible costs; record visible policy update dates.

Stopping condition: Stop when all six cases have cited compliance and fee assessments, all defects have corrections, and the three policy contrasts are stated.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.description: Evaluate the resolution of Case U1. Full credit if the agent provides the scope, compliance verdict, required version/repository, deadline, licence, fee eligibility and its conditions, section-level citations, and a minimal correction for any defect based on UKRI policy. Full credit if the policy page is unavailable and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if the resolution is provided but is missing some required fields or the correction.

Evaluate the resolution of Case U2. Full credit if the agent provides the scope, compliance verdict, required version/repository, deadline, licence, fee eligibility and its conditions, section-level citations, and a minimal correction for any defect based on UKRI policy. Evaluate the resolution of Case W1. Full credit if the agent provides the scope, compliance verdict, required version/repository, deadline, licence, fee eligibility and its conditions, section-level citations, and a minimal correction for any defect based on Wellcome policy. Full credit if the policy page is unavailable and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if the resolution is provided but is missing some required fields or the correction.

Evaluate the resolution of Case W2. Full credit if the agent provides the scope, compliance verdict, required version/repository, deadline, licence, fee eligibility and its conditions, section-level citations, and a minimal correction for any defect based on Wellcome policy. Full credit if the policy page is unavailable and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if the resolution is provided but is missing some required fields or the correction.

Evaluate the resolution of Case E1. Full credit if the agent provides the scope, compliance verdict, required version/repository, deadline, licence, fee eligibility and its conditions, section-level citations, and a minimal correction for any defect based on ERC Horizon 2020 policy. Full credit if the policy page is unavailable and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if the resolution is provided but is missing some required fields or the correction.

items.criterion: Resolve Case E2 (ERC Horizon Europe Chapter)

items.criterion: Contrast publication obligations and eligible costs
items.description: Evaluate if the agent states exactly three contrasts between publication obligations and eligible costs based on the analyzed policies. Full credit for providing three distinct and accurate contrasts, OR if the pages were completely inaccessible and the agent reports being unable to determine the contrasts. Partial credit if only one or two contrasts are provided.

Evaluate if the agent records the visible update dates of the policies consulted. Full credit if update dates are provided for the accessed policies, OR if the agent explicitly notes that no update dates were visible or that the pages were inaccessible. Partial credit if the agent fails to record dates for some successfully accessed policies that display them.
